subject: gk
question: Which scheme is NOT proposed to be covered under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Nidhi?

options.text: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
Ayushman Bharat - Health and Wellness Centres (AB-HWCs)

solution:
The correct answer is** ​Rashtriya Swasthya Aashwasan Yojana (RSAY).**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Under Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Nidhi** there is no scheme like Rashtriya Swasthya Aashwasan Yojana (RSAY)​. **
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY)** was declared in 2003 with the aims of correcting regional imbalances in the availability of affordable/ reliable tertiary healthcare services and also to increase facilities for standard medical education in the country.
 
• **Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)** is the world's largest health insurance/ assurance scheme fully financed by the government.
 
• The **Ayushman Bharat - Health and Wellness Centres (AB-HWCs)** were started under the Ayushman Bharat Program in a bid to move away from selective health care to a more comprehensive range of services spanning inhibitory, remedial, rehabilitative and palliative care for all ages.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• There are hundreds of government schemes in India that basis on** social and economic. **
 
• Every year use many schemes are started to **help the citizen conquer all the economic and social problems. **
 
• All the schemes for **public well-being.​ **

2f:T
